current_focus.summary: What DinkusKit Reviews owns and how it is separate from Commerce.

decisions.choice: Their own plugin, DinkusKit Reviews, in its own repository. It hands each product two numbers, an average rating and a review count, and the storefront and agent catalog read those without knowing how reviews were collected.

history.choice: Their own plugin, DinkusKit Reviews, in its own repository. It hands each product two numbers, an average rating and a review count, and the storefront and agent catalog read those without knowing how reviews were collected.

decisions.question: Do product ratings and reviews live inside Commerce or in their own plugin?
decisions.rationale: Owner, 15 Nov 2026 00:19 UTC, replying to that recommendation: 'agreed instead of merging in 128 lets actually scaffold the dinkuskit/* repo'. An owner gets reviews without choosing a third-party app as on Shopify, and Commerce stays small.

decisions.choice: Buyers only. A buyer reviews through a one-time link in the email sent after their order ships; the link proves they bought that product, so no account is needed. There is no open 'write a review' form in the first version. If one is ever added, a review from it stays hidden until the reviewer confirms by email, and is never published before that.

history.choice: Buyers only. A buyer reviews through a one-time link in the email sent after their order ships; the link proves they bought that product, so no account is needed. decisions.question: Who may leave a review: buyers only, or anyone?
decisions.rationale: Owner answered 'lock it' on 22 Nov 2026 to the four recommended answers. Hands-on study of the three most used Shopify review apps on a sandbox store (Nov 2026) and docs/research/product-ratings.md support it. The leading apps accept reviews from an open form by default and two of the three publish them before checking the email address, which invites fake reviews.

decisions.choice: Published straight away, for every star rating alike, because only buyers can review. The owner can hide spam and abuse afterwards and reply. A store setting switches to approve-first, and then every review waits, whatever its stars. Stars are never used to decide what is held back.

history.choice: Published straight away, for every star rating alike, because only buyers can review. The owner can hide spam and abuse afterwards and reply. decisions.question: Is a review published straight away or does it wait for approval?
decisions.rationale: Owner answered 'lock it' on 22 Nov 2026 to the four recommended answers. Hands-on study of the three most used Shopify review apps on a sandbox store (Nov 2026) and docs/research/product-ratings.md support it. All three apps publish by default. Holding back only low-star reviews, which one app allows, risks the US rule against suppressing reviews (16 CFR Part 465).

decisions.choice: Each store's own rating, carried on that store's offer. Ratings are never blended across stores. A rating filter in the catalog tests the offer's own rating and count. Sharing reviews between stores owned by the same business is left for later.

history.choice: Each store's own rating, carried on that store's offer. Ratings are never blended across stores. A rating filter in the catalog tests the offer's own rating and count. Sharing reviews between stores owned by the same business is left for later.

decisions.question: When several stores sell the same product, does the cross-store catalog show one blended rating or each store's own?
decisions.rationale: Owner answered 'lock it' on 22 Nov 2026 to the four recommended answers. Hands-on study of the three most used Shopify review apps on a sandbox store (Nov 2026) and docs/research/product-ratings.md support it. Shopify's catalog filters on each offer's own rating; the review apps keep ratings per store. A blended score would let one seller's reviews raise or sink another's, and inferred product matches would mix unrelated products.

decisions.choice: No. The first version is stars with optional words. Photos, and any reward for adding one, come later on the owner's word; a reward would be offered the same for every star rating and the review marked as rewarded.

history.choice: No. The first version is stars with optional words. Photos, and any reward for adding one, come later on the owner's word; a reward would be offered the same for every star rating and the review marked as rewarded.

decisions.question: Do reviews carry photos in the first version?
decisions.rationale: Owner answered 'lock it' on 22 Nov 2026 to the four recommended answers. Hands-on study of the three most used Shopify review apps on a sandbox store (Nov 2026) and docs/research/product-ratings.md support it. Photos need media upload and more bundle room; collection, moderation and the rating should be proven first.
